item.title: Two Martin County brush fires contained, Florida Forest Service warns more expected this summer
item.description:
Martin County saw two brush fires this week, including one sparked by a lightning strike. Both fires are now fully contained and being monitored by the Florida Forest Service.

item.description: Tioniea Hines, 22, is being held in St. Lucie County Jail on $75,000 bond.

item.title: Czech tennis player Linda Noskova wins Wimbledon after recovering from blown match points
item.description: Linda Noskova recovered from a second-set meltdown in which she wasted five match points to overcome Karolina Muchova 6-2, 5-7, 6-3 in an all-Czech final Saturday for her first Grand Slam trophy.

item.title: Karolina Muchova defeats Coco Gauff at Wimbledon in dramatic tiebreaker
item.description: Karolina Muchova ended Coco Gauff's run at Wimbledon with a 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 victory Thursday that ended with a drama-filled tiebreaker to reach the final.

item.title: Park Vista football team aims for state playoffs after strong late-season finish
item.description: Park Vista Community High School's football team is building on late-season momentum as the Cobras set their sights on the state playoffs in 2026 after winning four of their last five games in 2025.
